title: Fuzzy normed BCK-algebras and BCI-algebras
summary: In this paper, we introduce and study the notion of fuzzy normed BCK-algebras and fuzzy normed BCI-algebras as a natural extension of clas sical normed algebraic structures into the fuzzy setting. A fuzzy norm on a BCK/BCI-algebra is defined as a mapping from the algebra and a positive real parameter into the unit interval satisfying suitable axioms analogous to those of fuzzy normed linear spaces.
